subject.why: Clearly depicts the thatched cottage with all requested elements.

category.why: Grounded on a wide lawn with a low camera angle and clear sky.

clean.why: No text, UI, borders, or characters present.

framing.why: Centred with clear margins and a solid silhouette.

colour.why: Bright and warm with clean separation from the background.

detail.why: Contains a cluster of dozens of small, repeated rose blooms around the door.

style.why: Consistent chunky 3D volumes with appropriate satin finish.

fix: Simplify the rose arch by replacing the numerous small flowers with fewer, chunkier stylized blooms.
